name: CARS24
h1: Built by Builders, ready for listing day
lede: CARS24 is moving through its reverse flip towards DRHP eligibility while running as a title-less, AI-first organisation. Airtable gives Builders shared, visible ownership of every workstream on the road to listing.
why_h2: IPO readiness meets a new way of working
why_p: Four moves since June 2026 that all depend on clear ownership, controls and cross-team handoffs.

signals.title: DRHP eligibility targeted by April
signals.body: India CFO Shivanshu Makkar said CARS24 expects to be eligible to file its DRHP by April once the reverse flip from Singapore to India completes.
signals.angle: Finance, legal and audit workstreams need one tracker with owners, evidence and approvals before filing.

signals.title: From 25 to around 200 cities
signals.body: Coverage of the CFO's remarks noted CARS24 could expand its retail presence from 25 to around 200 Indian cities.
signals.angle: City launches repeat the same playbook many times. Airtable turns it into a shared template every team can run.

signals.title: Every employee becomes a Builder
signals.body: CARS24 removed all job titles, grades and bands under its Flatland operating philosophy.
signals.angle: Without titles, contribution needs to be visible. Shared bases show who owns which outcome and where it stands.

signals.title: AI Labs launched with US$20 million
signals.body: CARS24 launched AI Labs with a US$20 million commitment to AI startups and AI-first products, partnering with OpenAI, AWS and ElevenLabs.
signals.angle: AI workflows still need human review steps. Airtable coordinates the data and approvals around them across teams.
